title: A note on irreducible slice algebraic sets
summary: In this short note we prove that if $I$ is a right radical and quasi prime ideal in the ring of quaternionic slice regular polynomials, then the symmetrization $\mathbb S_{V_c(I)}$ is an irreducible algebraic set, where $V_c(I)$ is the set of common zeros with commuting components of polynomials in $I$. Combining this fact with the results proved in our previous paper [3], we obtain that for $I$ radical, $V_c(I)$ is irreducible if and only if $I$ is quasi prime.
